tickets.title: Consequence ledger: append-only world fact store
tickets.description: The cheapest high-value system in the project. Also the save file. Doc 04 and Doc 14.

tickets.title: Ledger query layer for tension sourcing
tickets.description: Weighted queries over world facts, used as the primary input to Tier 1 quest generation.

tickets.title: Graph-rewriting engine
tickets.description: Shared by quest missions and dungeon missions. Different ruleset, same code. Doc 09.

tickets.title: Tension sampling from live world state
tickets.description: Contested cells, broken resource dependencies, hostility pairs, Pressure advance, Custodian secrets, and unresolved player consequences.

tickets.title: Quest expansion ruleset (~30 rules)
tickets.description: Rewrite abstract nodes into concrete structures two or three levels deep. Small ruleset, enormous space.

tickets.title: Quest binding pass
tickets.description: Resolve every node to a real faction, NPC, dungeon or road. Binding is where generated becomes specific.

tickets.title: Quest validation pass
tickets.description: Reachability, no ledger contradictions, difficulty within budget, at least one refusable node. Discard failures.

tickets.title: Bias the grammar toward two-claimants-one-object
tickets.description: The best quest shape in existence: both parties have a legitimate case and the player cannot satisfy both.

tickets.title: Enforce: every quest moves a visible number
tickets.description: Territory, supply status, faction strength, a route opening or closing. If nothing observable changes, it was a chore.

tickets.title: Tier 0 contract board
tickets.description: Honest job board with a price and no dramatic framing. Capped supply or priced so nobody grinds it.

tickets.title: Tier 2: author the main quest spine
tickets.description: Fixed beats, variable cast and locations. Explicitly NOT generated — the failure would be unrecoverable.

tickets.title: Tier 2: procedural cast binding for the spine
tickets.description: Bind the authored beats to whichever factions and NPCs this seed produced.

tickets.title: Faction questlines
tickets.description: One per faction role, authored and cast-bound like the spine.

tickets.title: Author 15-20 set-piece quests tied to landmark archetypes
tickets.description: Place procedurally, play as designed. These are what players remember.

tickets.title: Forge-time region tiers
tickets.description: Rings or branches out from the start point, baked into the manifest. Difficulty as a property of place.

tickets.title: Budget encounters against the ledger, not level
tickets.description: The generator knows the player's actual gear, charges and allies.

tickets.title: Refusal paths for every generated quest
tickets.description: Including walking away and telling the other side. Without it, quests have no moral weight.

tickets.title: Journal: prose entries recording who, what, where, decided
tickets.description: With no quest markers the journal is load-bearing. Doc 13.
